title: Argo CD: Sourcing a Helm Chart
description: Argo CD templates a Helm chart and applies the output directly -- no Helm release ever exists. --helm-set, --values-literal-file, and --values, and when each one actually works

steps.title: Genuinely Helm-templated, invisible to the helm CLI
--helm-set and --helm-set-string, same rules as plain Helm
A whole values file, with no repo to commit it to
--values needs a file that actually exists in the source
